title: Logarithmic correspondence-coloring bound for fixed forbidden cliques
exact_target: For each fixed $r>=4$, do constants $C_r,Delta_r$ exist such that every finite $K_r-subgraph-free$ graph of maximum degree $Delta>=Delta_r$ has correspondence chromatic number at most $ceil(C_r$ Delta/log Delta)?
